errorCodes.meaning: No election with this identifier exists for this community.
Voting is not open, or the election key is not formed.
The election is open, or the cast's form (`sealed` or `encrypted`) is not the election's level.
An encrypted ballot's proofs do not verify, or it does not answer the manifest's questions in order.
The attestation does not verify for this election and this ballot.
The manifest refuses a revote and a cast under this tag is counted.

BoardHead.description: A board's tree head (RFC 9162 §2.1). A head is signed by being carried in a document the ballot box signs; whoever keeps a head keeps that whole document.

rootHash.description: The RFC 9162 Merkle tree hash (SHA-256) of the first `treeSize` entries, as a multihash.

BoardHead.title: BoardHead

DigestMultibase.description:
A cryptographic digest as a multibase-encoded multihash — the encoding the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 defines for `digestMultibase`, and the one `did:webvh` uses for its SCID and entry hashes.

Multihash carries the hash algorithm in-band, so the value is self-describing and the wire format survives an algorithm change without a schema revision; multibase does the same for the base encoding, so a verifier never infers base58 from base64url by context. A bare hex string or a `sha-256:`-style prefix hard-codes one algorithm into the wire contract and is non-conforming here.

This definition constrains the *encoding only*. What the digest is computed over is stated by each referencing field, because it differs legitimately: a digest over a JSON document is taken over its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, while a digest over an opaque artifact is taken over its bytes. A field whose input is a JSON document and which does not name a canonicalization is not reproducible.

Restricted to the two multibase headers W3C Controlled Identifiers 1.0 §2.4 normatively requires — `z` (base58btc) and `u` (base64url-no-pad). CID permits others but states that "interoperability is not guaranteed between implementations using such values", and a registry whose purpose is interoperability should not mint digests a conforming verifier may be unable to read. The alphabets are enforced rather than assumed: base58btc excludes 0, O, I and l, and an earlier permissive pattern let three published examples carry digests that were not valid base58 at all. base58btc is RECOMMENDED, for consistency with `did:key` and `did:webvh`.
DigestMultibase.title: DigestMultibase

DisjunctiveProof.description: A disjunctive proof that a ciphertext encrypts one value of a public list: one `(c, z)` per value, in the list's order (CONVENTIONS §9.3).
DisjunctiveProof.title: DisjunctiveProof

ElGamalCiphertext.description: `(a, b) = (r·G, M + r·Y)` under the election key `Y` (CONVENTIONS §9.2).
ElGamalCiphertext.title: ElGamalCiphertext

ElectionId.description: An election's identifier, unique within its community. A closed alphabet: it appears in the ticket class label `voter/<electionId>` and is framed into every hash a cast is bound to.
ElectionId.title: ElectionId

EncryptedBallot.description: A tallied-encrypted ballot: one EncryptedQuestion per manifest question, in the manifest's order. Never decrypted (VTI-VOT-064).
EncryptedBallot.title: EncryptedBallot

EncryptedCast.description: A cast of a sealed or tallied-encrypted election: exactly one of `sealed` (the Ballot's JCS bytes sealed to the election key) or `encrypted`, with the tag and the attestation over the JCS bytes of whichever is present (CONVENTIONS §3.6, §9.5).
EncryptedCast.title: EncryptedCast

EncryptedQuestion.description: One choice question of a tallied-encrypted ballot: per option, in the manifest's order, an encryption of 0 or 1 with its proof; and a proof that the selections sum to a count the question admits (CONVENTIONS §9.5).
EncryptedQuestion.title: EncryptedQuestion

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupElement.description: A Ristretto group element: its 32-byte compression, multibase base58btc. Never the identity (CONVENTIONS §9.1).
GroupElement.title: GroupElement

GroupScalar.description: A scalar mod the Ristretto group order: 32 canonical little-endian bytes, multibase base58btc (CONVENTIONS §9.1).
GroupScalar.title: GroupScalar

Key.description: A question or option key, unique within its manifest or question.
Key.title: Key

Multibase.description: A binary value, multibase base58btc over the suite's canonical (compressed) encoding.
Multibase.title: Multibase

leafIndex.description: The board index of this cast's `encryptedCast` entry.

Response.title: Voting — Ballot — Cast Encrypted — response payload

SealedPayload.description: Bytes sealed to a key: a random group element encrypted as `kem`, and the bytes under ChaCha20-Poly1305 with a key derived from it, multibase base58btc (CONVENTIONS §9.4).
SealedPayload.title: SealedPayload

SigmaProof.description: A non-interactive sigma proof as its challenge and response `(c, z)` (Schnorr or Chaum–Pedersen; CONVENTIONS §9.3).
SigmaProof.title: SigmaProof

schema.description: A voter casts a sealed or tallied-encrypted ballot, admitted by its PCS attestation and, when tallied-encrypted, by its proofs of validity.
